title: Feeling Tanky
author: Braindead_Games
selftext:
Press Space and your tank’s gravity flips. The ceiling is now your floor.

That one mechanic turned into a whole game: **Feeling Tanky**, a 2D tank shooter set in a mech-punk foundry full of brass, steam and things that want you dead.

**A few things you can do:**

* 🔄 Flip gravity mid-fight to dodge shots or ambush from above
* 🛡️ Time your guard right to **deflect** shots back at whoever fired them
* 🔧 Build your tank in the garage, with 14 weapons from Railguns to Saw Launchers to a Grav Cannon that flips whatever it hits
* 💣 Equip 3 of 13 abilities: holo decoys, proximity mines, sentry turrets, missile barrages, phase shift…
* ⚙️ Hunt down 30 hidden Brass Cogs tucked into the nastiest corners of 10 levels
* 👹 Take on 3 bosses, including a hovering Gyro Colossus and the Brass Leviathan

Gear unlocks as you clear levels, cosmetics unlock through challenges, and there are 3 difficulties. Iron Veteran roughly quadruples the enemies and is genuinely mean.

I’m looking for honest feedback:

* Is flipping gravity fun, or does it make you dizzy?
* What’s the most broken build you can make?
* Where did you get stuck?

🎮 **Play it here:** [https://braindeadgames.itch.io/feeling-tanky](https://braindeadgames.itch.io/feeling-tanky)  
🎬 **Trailer:** [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tdeppjHIjuk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tdeppjHIjuk)
